## Topics

- The tidyverse data philosophy and the native pipe (|>)
- Row filtering with filter() and logical conditions
- Column selection, renaming, and helpers with select() and rename()
- Creating and modifying variables with mutate()
- Sorting datasets with arrange() and desc()
